Bullish proposals advocate chasing altcoins like DOT, GALA, and ADA that have extended into overbought territory with RSI readings near or above 70, presenting unacceptable risk of sharp mean-reversions. Given the 1.2% round-trip spot friction, bid-ask spreads, and 31.2% tax on gains, entering late-stage momentum moves in a choppy regime is expected to bleed remaining capital. Maintaining 100% cash in the spot book protects against unnecessary churn, while the futures book remains permanently halted at its capital floor.
